title: Warrior's Demise Triptych
description: A three-panel image shows the same armored male warrior in sequential stages: standing ready with sword and shield on the left, mid-air in a dramatic falling pose with fiery wing-like effects in the center, and lying dead on the ground with coins spilling from his body on the right.
prompt: A three-panel vertical triptych against a solid black background showing the same muscular male fantasy warrior. Left panel: he stands in a combat pose wearing ornate bronze and gold armor with tattered blue skirt, holding a dagger and shield. Center panel: he is falling backwards through the air in a dynamic pose with fiery ethereal wing effects bursting from his back. Right panel: he lies dead on the ground with coins spilling from his body, armor damaged, eyes closed. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed, realistic textures.
